text: SASAC, the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of China's State Council, lists Sinochem Holdings (中国中化控股有限责任公司) as entry 43 in its directory of central state-owned enterprises (央企名录); the European Rubber Journal calls Sinochem a Chinese state-owned investor.
short: Sinochem Holdings is a Chinese central state-owned enterprise under SASAC.

source.name: SASAC (国务院国资委) - 央企名录 (central state-owned enterprises directory)
source.quote: 43 中国中化控股有限责任公司

additionalSources.name: European Rubber Journal: Sinochem completes €1bn sale of Pirelli stake to Czech investor
additionalSources.quote: the Italian government moved to curb the influence of Chinese state-owned investor Sinochem
